source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to materials and energy (PDF 217-218).

blocks.text: Insan qadeem zamane se apni rozmarra zaruraton ke liye qudrati wasail (natural resources) se faida uthata aaya hai. Sab se qadeem materials lakri, dhatein (metals) aur janwaron se milne wali cheezein hain, jaise kapre. Aabadi mein bohat izafe aur mehdood qudrati wasail ki wajah se naye materials aur machines ki zarurat pari. Is se bohat se materials ijad hue, metal alloys se nanomaterials tak, aur bare electric cells se bohat kaarguzar chhoti batteries tak. Computers, mobile phones, tameerati machinery aur hawai jahaz jaisi machines sab jadeed materials aur energy devices ka majmua hain.

blocks.title: Mobile phone ke andar (Figure 31.1)
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 31.1 mobile phone ki tasveer hai. Phone mein mukhtalif dhatein, plastics aur un ke composites hote hain, aur saath aik chhota lekin kaarguzar energy device: lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery.

Yeh chapter jadeed materials aur tawanai (energy) ke zaraye mein chemistry ka kirdar batata hai. Is mein metals, alloys, polymers aur ceramics ki tayyari, khasiyatein aur istemal, aur un ke mutale ka aik tajziyati tareeqa, X-ray crystallography, shamil hai. Phir energy density aur specific energy, fossil fuel, nuclear aur solar energy, tawanai ke istemal ke mahol par asraat, aur pa-idar (sustainable) energy ke zaraye dekhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Mobile phone mein materials ki qismein aur us ka energy device batayein.
blocks.explanation: Metals, plastics aur composites; energy device lithium-ion battery hai.

items: Barhti aabadi ke liye naye materials aur energy devices chahiye the.
Phone mein metals, plastics, composites aur Li-ion battery hain.
